material_definitions: Aliovalent substitution was performed in Li6+xP1-xGexS5I, resulting in argyrodite structure.
The resulting structural changes, including lattice variations, Ge solubility, and Li+ occupancies/I /S2  sitedisorder, were monitored.
The structural changes and increasing lattice volume lead to an opening of the bottle necks and facile inter-cage jumps.
warnings: Temperature is inferred as room temperature (25 C) as it was not explicitly stated in the text.

material_definitions: The class of argyrodites Li6PS5X (X = Cl, Br, I) has attracted considerable interest.
If iodine is the halide in the structure (Li6PS5I), no site-disorder occurs due to the large size mismatch between S2– and I–.
This absence of disorder is associated with high activation barriers for ion migration and low ionic conductivity.
warnings: Value cited from external source (Kraft et al.).
Temperature (25 Celsius) is inferred as room temperature (RT) since it was not explicitly stated.

material_definitions: The Li+ superionic argyrodites Li(6+x)P(1-x)GexS5I have been synthesized with increasing Ge4+/P5+ ratios.
Full solid solutions of Li(6+x)P(1-x)GexS5I can be synthesized up to a composition of at least Li6.7P0.3Ge0.7S5I.
Samples exhibit minor impurity phase fractions of LiI and/or Li4GeS4.
The highest conductivity was achieved for this composition, measured via impedance spectroscopy on cold pressed pellets.
